body:
Granulose

A small mod that adds a few new powders, along with a new weapon to take advantage of them.

## The Powder Flail The powder flail is a pouch connected to long rope. It can be thrown with the **Use** button (right click by default), which deals damage on contact and can have various effects depending on what powders are stored inside it.
## Powders - **Sand Pile** - increases the powder flail's damage by 1 per sand pile. - **Snow Powder** - freezes entities on contact (like powder snow). more snow powder means longer freeze. - **Gunpowder** - it explodes on contact with an entity or a block. more gunpowder means bigger explosion. This also consumes the gunpowder. - **Scorch Powder** - applies the scorching effect, which acts like fire but cannot be put out by water. more scorch powder means higher duration and level. It also creates a scorch fire block when hitting a block. - **Ocean Powder** - applies the Ocean's Curse effect, which prevents all forms of swimming, and takes oxygen when not submerged in water. more ocean powder means higher duration and level. This also has the added bonus of making the powder flail travel faster underwater. - **Draco Powder** - bypasses armor by 33% per draco powder. ## Extras - **The Sand Pile** can also be thrown without a powder flail with the Use button, giving blindness to any entity caught in its cloud. - **The Gunpowder Block** is basically more volatile tnt. have fun. - **The bundle** is available in survival by default (a bundle is used in the powder flail recipe).
